messages:
Eli (sales): Heads-up — Acme asked to expand the trial. They want streaming embeddings + a strict latency SLO (150ms p99) for the chat surface. Also BYO-KMS and a completed security questionnaire by end of week. Pricing question: how does adding embeddings + dedicated capacity change the quote?

Priya (solutions): Quick clarifying Qs — are they asking for embeddings in real-time per message or async periodic upserts? Also, what exact success criteria do they want for the chat (latency only, or quality metrics as well)?

Eli (sales): They said "real-time" initially but seem flexible. For success criteria they called out latency p99 = 150ms and "comparable" answer quality to their current baseline. No concrete eval set yet.

Marco (eng): 150ms p99 is pretty aggressive for hosted for anything >~128 tokens. If they mean token generation + rerank it’s likely impossible without Dedicated and NVLink/gpu-local KV cache. Need sample prompts and token budgets.

Priya (solutions): Proposal: narrow POC to 2 use cases (support triage chat + search rerank). Define an eval set: 120 queries total (40 per intent) run vs baseline. Pass criteria: >=90% issue-identification accuracy (human-annotated), and latency p99 <= 250ms for the initial run. We can try to optimize toward 150ms later. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Marco (eng): That is reasonable. For 250ms p99 we can stay on hosted if we constrain max tokens and enable prefix/KV caching + continuous batching. For 150ms we should provision Dedicated pool with: 2x A100 (or equivalent), persistent KV cache, and custom batching. Also BYO-KMS is fine but adds ~3 business days to onboarding + legal signoff.

Jasmine (security): BYO-KMS + audit logs — we can support. Need completed security questionnaire items Q4 (KMS architecture), Q7 (data retention), and Q11 (access control). I can answer but need the questionnaire doc. Also will need timeline for their legal/security review; BYO-KMS usually triggers extra compliance review.

Eli (sales): Uploaded their questionnaire here: https://acme.example.com/secure/questionnaire (internal note: customer link). Pricing note: adding embeddings (streaming) increases per-call costs and indexing storage. If they want Dedicated it's add-on rental pricing + monthly commit. I'll get exact numbers from finance but need to know scope first.

Marco (eng): Minimal POC config we can spin up quickly:

```json
{
  "model": "redwood-star-7b-q4f",
  "deployment": "dedicated" ,
  "nodes": 2,
  "kv_cache": true,
  "batching": { "max_batch_tokens": 2048, "latency_target_ms": 250 },
  "embeddings": { "mode": "streaming", "upsert_rate": "60s" },
  "kms": "customer",
  "rollout": "canary"
}
```

Marco (eng): If we want to avoid Dedicated for the first week, change deployment to "hosted" and set embeddings.upsert_rate to "300s" and latency_target_ms to 350. That reduces costs and setup time.

Priya (solutions): Decision proposal: 1) Scope POC to chat + rerank only. 2) Run initial 1-week hosted trial with reduced embeddings frequency (300s) and 250ms p99 goal. 3) If eval pass (>=90% quality), spin Dedicated to chase 150ms SLO for production pilot. Priya to own evals, Marco to provision infra, Jasmine to drive questionnaire answers. Agree? :white_check_mark:

Eli (sales): Sounds good. I'll confirm with Acme that they're ok with the two-stage approach and the slightly relaxed initial SLO. Also asking for sample prompts and baseline logs by tomorrow EOD.

Jasmine (security): I'll start filling Q4/Q7/Q11 and loop in legal. Expect first draft in 48 hours.

Marco (eng): Created infra ticket INF-1234 to track Dedicated provisioning and hosted workaround config. Will post progress updates there.

deploy-bot: Ticket INF-1234 created by Marco for provisioning (assignee: infra-team).

Eli (sales): I'll update pricing ask once finance confirms numbers for streaming embeddings + 2-node Dedicated. Back to Acme now.

Priya (solutions): Action items recap in thread:
- Eli: confirm two-stage plan with customer + collect prompt set/baseline logs (due tomorrow).
- Priya: build eval harness and sample prompts (due +3 days).
- Marco: start INF-1234, prepare hosted config and Dedicated sizing options (due +2 days).
- Jasmine: draft security questionnaire responses (due 48h).

Eli (sales): Thanks all — will ping once customer confirms. :thumbsup:
